mixed.deterministic_schedule: index mod100:0..69 JSON;70..89 DB;90..98 timer;99 CPU

cpu_algorithm.integer: signed64 in Ku/Go/Rust; Node exact Number intermediates <2^53

batch.cold_start: repeat=0 in a fresh process, reported separately; never subtracted from repeat=64

resources.driver_cpuset: 4-6 if8vCPU available; actual written in environment manifest
resources.unmatched_admission_controls: record actual native framework semantics; no artificial slow layer

SLO.primary_latency: scheduled-to-complete; sent-to-complete and schedule lag also shown
SLO.ordinary_absolute_timeout_origin: scheduled arrival, including client queue/dial/write/read and full response validation
SLO.waiting_deadline_scope: dedicated long-wait instances only; 35s timer / 30s TCP hold cannot fit ordinary server default30s; ordinary matrix unchanged

matrix.waiting_stop: confirmed hard limit/SLO/resource failure; no higher fake capacity
matrix.sustained_rate: 60% of minimum nonzero five-round verified mixed capacity; mark partial-stack comparison if any stack has no verified qualified point; never use provisional short-window capacity
matrix.warmup_policy: 30 seconds once for every stack and CPU/memory/workload case; native services retained between interleaved rounds only after all actual jobs are drained
matrix.inactive_services: whole idle service cgroup frozen between interleaved rounds, freeze/resume history retained; 3s prime excluded uniformly
matrix.vm_memory_fallback: if whole guest available memory falls below 800MiB while retaining idle services, restart every stack for that case and repeat uniform 30s warmup; record fallback
matrix.waiting_warmup: all stacks: 30s at32rps of ordinary25ms timer before the held cohort; complete all responses before baseline

measurement.all_outcomes: mutually exclusive; failed results never excluded from denominators
measurement.late: associated event, not second terminal count
measurement.events: bounded streaming compressed CSV allowed; output overflow invalidates run
measurement.small_tail_samples: fewer than 100 correct observations has no p99; do not claim SLO compliance. Five formal round distributions are merged, never average percentiles
measurement.driver_headroom: driver invalidity or CPU saturation censors server capacity; it is not a server capacity failure
measurement.planned_window_tail: stop creating plans at the frozen window end; already planned requests may start and complete until their original scheduled+absolute deadline. Do not discard at window cutoff, renew deadlines, replay, or credit completion-tail throughput to the window
measurement.overload_recovery_origins: primary: planned arrival cutoff+5s unchanged; secondary: separately report last actual business sent+5s and continued-offering tail; secondary never rescues failed primary

json_response_mime.ku: text/plain; charset=utf-8 via current native http.text; decoded/encoded body validated as JSON
json_response_mime.claim: body-equivalent business comparison; no claim of identical response-header API capability

known_capability_differences.json_subtree_ownership: Ku accessor copies decoded subtree; Rust moves it; Go and Node retain decoded object references. Normal API costs included, no artificial copies added to counterparts.
